acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:2daebe8c-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. You'll lead Vanta's EMEA Solutions Engineering team across the Growth and Commercial segments, developing a strong group of eight SEs while evolving our technical sales motion and helping drive growth in one of Vanta's highest-priority regions. Solutions Engineering at Vanta sits at the intersection of product, technical, and sales. The SE team works alongside Account Executives to drive technical wins, lead discovery, and make the fit between customer needs and Vanta's capabilities real, converting qualified opportunities into closed revenue. In EMEA, that means operating across a wide and diverse market: from established financial and technology hubs across Western Europe to emerging opportunities across the Middle East, Israel, and Southern Europe, each with different regulatory contexts, GRC maturity levels, and buying behaviours. The team needs to show up credibly across all of them. This manager leads the Growth and Commercial SE team, a group of eight SEs spanning a fast-moving, high-priority region. The SE motion is actively evolving from a repeatable demo approach toward a more consultative, value-based model in the right deals, while preserving speed and volume where that remains the right answer. The job is to develop the team and the motion together. claspgroup-clasp-group:ashbyhq:b8b2612d-.description: SENIOR FULLSTACK ENGINEER, LENDING (CLASP FINANCE) Remote (ET & CT time zones only – some travel required) ABOUT US Clasp is a venture-backed, mission-driven startup transforming access to education and career pathways. We are revolutionizing the way employers attract and retain critical talent and the way colleges and universities support their students through education financing — all while tackling the student debt crisis. (Yep, we think BIG.) We like to think of ourselves as more than a fintech; we're a catalyst for economic mobility. hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:e24e6a42-613b-46cb-b2a.description: 🚀 Why this role Panora is building the AI platform that will redefine how insurance brokers work across Europe. The problem is structural: brokers spend the majority of their time on repetitive, manual tasks (switching between carrier portals, chasing documents, re-entering data) instead of advising clients. The result? Underinsured businesses, frustrated brokers, and a profession stuck in the past. We believe AI can fix this. Not by replacing brokers, but by giving every broker the capabilities of the best one in the room: on every case, at every critical moment. That's the vision we've been pitching to VCs. That's what we're building. Panora has live product, first paying customers, and a roadmap far bigger than our current team. The foundations are solid, built with Hexa's support, with strong technical and product groundwork already in place. Now we need someone to take ownership of that vision and turn it into a product brokers love. You'll be our first Product hire. You won't just manage a backlog, you'll shape how an entire industry modernizes. You'll own the roadmap, build the product function from scratch, and make sure every feature we ship moves us closer to a world where no one is underinsured. 🎯 Your mission Take Panora's product from "it works" to "it's the reference": structure discovery, relentlessly prioritize, and quickly scope the features that unlock adoption and retention among brokerage firms. 📋 What you'll do Discovery: understand, explore, prototype - Field discovery: spend time with brokers (demos, calls, on-site visits) to understand their day-to-day quoting workflow and spot the real friction points, not surface-level requests. - Insurance domain interface: translate the constraints of brokerage and carriers (products, quoting rules, regulation) into product decisions. - Product design: frame flows and screens (with engineering support), keeping a high bar on simplicity for non-technical users. Delivery: prioritize, spec, ship - Roadmap & prioritization with founders: build and continuously arbitrate the product roadmap, make trade-offs between business impact, technical debt and speed, and say no. - Specs & delivery: write clear specs, scope work with engineers, and drive delivery end to end through to production. - Product voice internally: align sales and ops on the "what" and the "why," bridging customer needs and what we build. Own the weekly product meeting. - Data & impact: instrument, measure usage (activation, retention, feature adoption via PostHog) and close the loop between product decisions and results. Quality: make the AI trustworthy - AI agentic workflows: design and iterate on the AI agents at Panora's core (multi-carrier quoting, document generation, compliance checks). You define what the agent does, how it handles edge cases, and where the human stays in the loop. You work closely with engineering to tune prompts, evaluate outputs, and push coverage. - AI feedback loop: build the instrumentation that makes AI outputs improvable: capture broker corrections, flag low-confidence outputs, and turn real-world usage into a continuous improvement cycle. You own the gap between "AI generates" and "broker trusts." ✅ What we're looking for - 4-6 years of product experience, including at least one role in a B2B SaaS environment with real roadmap ownership. - You've already driven a product end to end: discovery → specs → delivery → impact measurement, autonomously. - Excellent prioritization and trade-off skills: you know how to focus a small team on what matters. - Analytical rigor: you make decisions with data, not gut feel alone. - Crystal-clear communication, written and spoken, with both technical AND non-technical audiences (customers, founders). - Experience with AI / automation-driven products. - Strong appetite for a complex, regulated domain : insurance doesn't scare you, it interests you. - You're comfortable with early-stage velocity and move forward without being told how. ➕ Bon

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:959d3f75-b060-4bb0.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку Backend Team Lead. Для нас важливий досвід: - Від 1 року досвіду на лідерських посадах у командах розробки із сильними навичками управління людьми, командою та ефективної комунікації. - “Граючий тренер” — легко можеш очолити команду, але не цураєшся робити таски руками. - 5+ років комерційного досвіду розробки на backend позиції. - Досвід роботи з PHP (Symfony) / Go, або стрімке бажання працювати з цим стеком. - Знання: SOLID, DDD, Microservices, Layered Architecture, GoF patterns, Clean Code. - Робота з реляційними СУБД (MySQL тощо). - Досвід роботи з чергами (RabbitMQ та інші). - Базові знання Kubernetes. Ключові виклики, які будуть стояти перед тобою: - Керівництво, координація та розвиток команди backend розробників; - Відповідальність за розробку в крос-функціональній команді MarTech, яка створює технічні рішення для маркетингу; - Найм та формування команди; - Співпраця зі стейкхолдерами; - Забезпечення високої якості коду та дотримання найкращих практик розробки у команді; - Взаємодія з суміжними командами з метою покращення взаємодії компонентів системи та оптимізації процесів; - Впровадження AI-підходів та технологій у процеси команди - від автоматизації рутини до нових продуктових рішень; - Покращення коду, архітектури, сервісів та підходів до розробки. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: - SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. - Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури.
